ModMetaData.name: RimMT Diagnostics v0.20.7 - Top-Level Tick Breakdown
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Low-overhead top-level tail diagnostics for RimMT. Measures complete ticks, the three vanilla TickLists, map/world stages, and exact top-level game managers. It does not patch Pawn, WorkGiver, GenClosest, Reachability, PathFinder or individual MapComponent overrides, avoiding the MoreFactionInteraction initialization regression. On-demand reports include RimMT production counters and Harmony ownership.
